subject: showcase
caption:
Church at one. Reception at three. Two different barangays.

That is where most of the messenger questions come from, and the answer is always the same: the address, then the address again, then a screenshot of a map. Somebody types it fifteen times.

On Jed and Steph's page, both venues sit there with a map that opens in one tap. The question stops being asked.

Message us your event date and we will show you yours.
